chosen_edition: The Army and Navy Hymnal (1920), no. 31

editorial.method: Human word-for-word comparison against the chosen edition required

notes: This edition prints three stanzas (the familiar 'No more let sins and sorrows grow' stanza is not included). The musically repeated final line of each stanza is given once, with the stanza-final punctuation; syllable hyphens and the sung Amen are omitted.
